qualified_behavior: Copy on a qualified volume row starts worker planning instead of ordinary file-copy planning.
The worker returns a complete immutable archive review before any destination write.
The review displays source identity, consistency, destination/archive, logical and stored bytes, object counts, sparse files, and explicit losses.
Only an approved review starts the existing sparse writer; cancellation is available while planning and archiving.
The footer reports planning, archiving, completion, indeterminate durability, cancellation, and failure states.
